items.title: Gambian children forced to beg for cash or face beatings
items.summary: By Dawda Baldeh Young children enrolled in local Quranic memorisation centres are being forced onto the streets of The Gambia to meet strict daily financial targets or face violent beatings from their teachers. At the bustling Jarra Soma bus garage along the Trans-Gambia corri...
